column1: # Reviewed Polish proper nouns pilot.
# Columns: family_id\tforms(; separated)\tbasis\tnote
# Canonical surface casing is intentional: CleverKeys CKDT can preserve the
# reviewed capitalized form through its canonical/normalized mapping.
# This is a project-owned reviewed source and does not automatically promote
# arbitrary names from external corpora.
# Sources used for this bounded expansion:
# - Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs / dane.gov.pl PESEL name statistics,
#   current living-person name dataset updated 2026-01-30.
# - Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs: top first names given in H1 2026,
#   published 2026-08-19.
# - Official GUS TERYT/SIMC + GUGiK PRNG naming registers for place-name
#   canonical spelling.
# This is deliberately a reviewed pilot, not an uncontrolled import of all
# personal names or all geographic names.
